sources.title: DESNZ Provisional UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics 2025
sources.observed_fact: 2025 UK net territorial greenhouse gas emissions provisionally estimated at 367 MtCO2e; subject to revision when final 2025 estimates are published.

sources.title: DESNZ Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics 1990 to 2024
sources.observed_fact: Final territorial series back to 1990; all years revised for methodological improvements and new data, superseding previous estimates.

sources.title: DESNZ UK territorial greenhouse gas emissions statistics collection
sources.observed_fact: Collection explicitly separates annual provisional and final territorial emissions publications and their update cadence.

sources.title: DESNZ Energy Trends UK gas
sources.observed_fact: Official gas statistics cover UK production, trade and demand; monthly development tables are two months in arrears and are activity data, not parcel emissions.

sources.title: DESNZ Gas statistics collection
sources.observed_fact: Collection covers gas production, imports, exports and consumption, with annual DUKES and quarterly/monthly Energy Trends surfaces.

sources.title: DESNZ Energy Trends and Prices statistical release 30 June 2026
sources.observed_fact: Latest release provides provisional monthly energy production, trade, consumption and prices; these are energy activity statistics rather than direct parcel greenhouse-gas measurements.

sources.title: DESNZ Natural gas statistics data sources and methodologies
sources.observed_fact: Methodology surface defines data sources and methods for natural gas statistics and is treated as method evidence, not an observed emissions row.

sources.title: DESNZ 2005 to 2024 UK local and regional greenhouse gas emissions technical report
sources.observed_fact: Technical report states around 97% of total CO2e GHG emissions from gas combustion are CO2 and documents gas-year/calendar-year and weather-correction differences; aggregate methods are not parcel binding.
